text: **WLO-0029 engineering prep done — 2026-09-13; PUBLICATION BLOCKED ON OWNER (q-000028/29/30).** Landed (remote-independent, verified locally): (1) **Versioning** — `wlo.application.gradle.kts` derives versionCode = `git rev-list --count HEAD` (monotonic, shared by both channels; verified: release APK reports versionCode=26 = current commit count) with `-Pwlo.versionCode=`/`WLO_VERSION_CODE=` CI override; versionName override same pattern (CI injects `x.y.z` on tags, `0.1.0-alpha.N+<sha>` on main). (2) **Signing** — one keystore for both channels, never committed: `keystore.properties` (git-ignored; example file in-repo) or `WLO_SIGNING_*` env; release falls back to the debug key locally so dev builds never break; local dogfood keystore generated at `~/.android/wlo-release.keystore` (channel identity of record for this machine). (3) **Publish workflow** `.github/workflows/release.yml` — push to main → signed APK + rolling `alpha` prerelease with commit-subject notes; `v*` tag → stable release; degrades to build-only with a warning when signing secrets are absent, so it can land before repo setup.
